name: Thomas F. Heffernan

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Louise Easen (b. England 4 Aug 1878, d. Philadelphia 16 Jun 1960, dau. of Thomas Easen & Mary Barnes)

events.title: Chairman, Luzerne County Republican Committee
events.description: Chaired the county Republican committee in the campaigns of 1903, 1904 and 1905; president of the Press Club of Wilkes-Barre

bioAdditions: A 1906 portrait of Thomas F. Heffernan appears as no. 1114 in Prominent Men of Wilkes-Barre and Vicinity (S2). Its caption-key adds facts not in the earlier sketches: educated at Wyoming Seminary, married Louise Easen on 20 June 1900, chairman of the Luzerne County Republican Committee during the 1903, 1904 and 1905 campaigns, and president of the Press Club of Wilkes-Barre. That was the year before Roosevelt made him postmaster. The state death index lists him on 28 Feb 1951, Wilkes-Barre, file 14086 (S1). FamilySearch gives 27 Feb 1951 and burial at Fern Knoll, Dallas Twp (S3).

conflicts.assessment: The official index says 28 Feb; keep 28 Feb.
